notes.title: Version 1.01
notes.content:
[h1]I updated the game to 1.01 version.[/h1]

[b]Big Things[/b]

- The bug that caused the game to crash on some systems when starting a new game or when leaving the first room has been fixed.

[b]Minor Things[/b]

- Logo intro can be skipped
- Made the player move faster in some rooms
- Fixes and adjustments on models and collision boundaries
